sketches.title: Mic bloom
sketches.description: A radial flower driven by the microphone: petals are frequency bands, bass swells the core.
sketches.interaction: tap to start the mic  ·  tap again to shift colors

sketches.title: Flow field
sketches.description: Particles drift along a Perlin noise vector field, leaving ink-like trails.
sketches.interaction: tap for a new seed  ·  hold to make a vortex
